results.check: Real restrictive page CSP blocks the baseline JavaScript URL default; noop helper dispatches each handler once, restores exact href, and produces no page CSP violation, including nested SVG
Functional/unknown JavaScript URLs, including URL-parser control-character schemes, are refused before any handler and retain attributes
Ordinary URL/button dispatch remains normal; SVG xlink noops restore, finally restores on thrown dispatch and preserves handler-written replacement href
All planned option clicks preflight before any question is changed; later unsupported href leaves earlier native radio unselected
Content preflights submit before remember(submitting): functional href causes no submit handler, submitting record, or uncertain record
Content normal noop submit + workpop confirm runs each existing handler once, records successful receipt, and restores both href attributes

scope: Fully intercepted disposable pages, real document CSP and main-world adapter/transport simulation; no real extension CSP, live course actions, or model calls. Removing a noop href can affect href-dependent site selectors; no transparency claim for arbitrary handlers.
